provenance.canonicalisation: RFC 8785 JCS via scripts/jcs.py; set hash is SHA-256 over JCS(vectors).
provenance.signatures: Ed25519 over domain || lowercase SHA-256 hex using fixed public test seeds; dependency-free RFC 8032 verifier.
provenance.status: candidate — no Demos runtime guarantee and no second-implementation cross-run yet
provenance.syntheticProofProfile: demos-bft-proof/test-1 fixtures define outputHash as SHA-256(JCS(storageOutput)), SHA-256(JCS(native transfer payload)), or SHA-256(JCS({accepted:true,operationId})); effectsRoot is SHA-256(JCS({pre,post})). These are test-only formulas, not production Demos wire claims.

coverage.note: Across the generated corpus, every applicable positive/negative/boundary cell of every rule ID has a rule-referenced fixture of the matching verdict class, and every non-applicable cell carries an explicit rationale; the generator and the strict validator both refuse a gap. Boundary cells count only boundaryRuleRefs. This gate counts rule references by class; it does not show that each fixture exercises its rule. Some cells are currently decided by self-reported or caller-supplied values, and strengthening them to the semantically meaningful fixtures CONFORMANCE-PLAN §14.8 requires remains open for this candidate.

vectors.name: aw-attempt-byte-identity
vectors.reason: Native attempt identity is distinct while Work bytes, authorizations, and workId remain immutable.

vectors.name: aw-attempt-changed-bytes
vectors.reason: Replacement cannot alter canonical Work bytes.

vectors.name: aw-replacement-with-noninclusion
vectors.reason: Authenticated authoritative non-inclusion permits a replacement attempt under the replacement-authority rule.

vectors.name: aw-replacement-effect-without-winner
vectors.reason: A Work-ledger inventory that records a business effect while the ledger selected no winning attempt shows an effect no winner fences.

vectors.name: aw-effect-inventory-stale-without-receipt
vectors.reason: Without a receipt, an inventory taken at a block other than the presented authenticated lifecycle evidence's does not establish the Work's business effects.

vectors.name: aw-effect-inventory-unbound-without-receipt
vectors.reason: Without a receipt or authenticated lifecycle evidence, no authenticated block binds the inventory, so the Work's business effects remain unavailable.

vectors.name: aw-replacement-on-not-found
vectors.reason: Ordinary not-found remains on the indeterminate side of the replacement-authority boundary.

vectors.name: aw-single-ledger-winner
vectors.reason: Exactly one included winner and business effect is the maximum valid cardinality.

vectors.name: aw-two-included-attempts
vectors.reason: A second included winner/effect crosses the Work-ledger cardinality boundary.

vectors.name: aw-attempt-evidence-native-ref-mismatch
vectors.reason: Signed lifecycle evidence for another native transaction cannot be attached to this attempt.

vectors.name: aw-exact-replay-returns-winner
vectors.reason: Exact replay returns the selected winner without execution or another fee/nonce effect.

vectors.name: aw-attempt-class-required
vectors.reason: Every transport attempt declares exactly one normal, replacement, or replay class before class-specific fields are interpreted.

vectors.name: aw-attempt-native-reference-duplicate
vectors.reason: A second attempt ID naming the first canonical native reference crosses the one-to-one identity boundary.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-ledger-winner-bound
vectors.reason: Receipt winner ID and native reference equal the authenticated ledger-selected attempt.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-ledger-winner-mismatch
vectors.reason: A separately finalized receipt cannot name another winning attempt.

vectors.name: aw-exact-replay-additional-fee
vectors.reason: An exact replay returns the old winner with zero additional fee and nonce effects.

vectors.name: aw-exact-replay-candidate-nonce
vectors.reason: The generic replay arm permits profile-selected nonce policy, but this advertised candidate fee rule forbids a new replay nonce.

vectors.name: aw-nonwinning-attempt-fee-rule
vectors.reason: The selected fee rule applies to every normal or replacement submission, not only the included winner.

vectors.name: aw-attempt-authenticated-nonce-mismatch
vectors.reason: The winning attempt nonce and fee must equal the subject authenticated by its ledger lifecycle evidence.

vectors.name: aw-replacement-replay-class-confusion
vectors.reason: An attempt cannot be classified simultaneously as a replacement and an exact replay, and replay requires an authenticated winner.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-ledger-outcome-mismatch
vectors.reason: A committed receipt cannot be paired with an authenticated included-rolled-back winner state.

vectors.name: aw-rolled-back-winner-records-no-business-effect
vectors.reason: A rolled-back winner claims no committed payment or other business effect, so the Work-ledger inventory at its finalized receipt block lists no attempt.

vectors.name: aw-rolled-back-winner-business-effect-recorded
vectors.reason: An inventory that records a business effect for a rolled-back winner contradicts its rolled-back receipt, which claims no committed payment or other business effect.

vectors.name: aw-attempt-proof-profile-mismatch
vectors.reason: Attempt lifecycle evidence binds the capability-selected proof profile and validator set.

vectors.name: aw-attempt-candidate-lifecycle-shape
vectors.reason: The generic schema leaves lifecycle evidence to the selected profile; this candidate accepts only its complete closed synthetic witness shape.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-complete-and-final
vectors.reason: A reconstructible complete proof closure binds ordered operations and business state while its fee/nonce effects grant no second-payment authority.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-capability-proof-profile-substitution
vectors.reason: Receipt verification uses the independently selected proof profile, not a substituted capability field.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-capability-schema-substitution
vectors.reason: Receipt verification consumes the exact authenticated payload-schema map.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-slot-validator-set-mismatch
vectors.reason: The authenticated slot before/after proof binds the capability-selected validator set as well as its proof profile.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-business-proof-profile-mismatch
vectors.reason: Business-root evidence cannot replay across a different capability proof profile.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-malformed-operation-payload
vectors.reason: A self-consistent receipt cannot bypass exact validation of the signed operation payload.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-storage-output-missing
vectors.reason: A committed storage operation must carry its complete output binding before output hashing or projection.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-slot-key-intent-mismatch
vectors.reason: Receipt payment-slot key must exactly equal the signed intent tuple.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-slot-before-generation-mismatch
vectors.reason: Purchase receipt slot before-state must equal the signed CAS expected state and generation.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-slot-after-generation-mismatch
vectors.reason: Purchase receipt terminal generation must equal the signed CAS generation.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-slot-after-digest-mismatch
vectors.reason: Purchase receipt terminal conflictDigest must equal the signed CAS payload.

vectors.name: aw-completion-receipt-mutates-settled-slot
vectors.reason: Completion must prove the settled slot is unchanged from before to after.

vectors.name: aw-completion-storage-bytes-content-hash-mismatch
vectors.reason: A self-consistent receipt cannot authenticate storage bytes whose signed contentHash names different decoded content.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-root-mismatch
vectors.reason: Receipt result order/content is committed by the RFC 6962 root.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-input-hash-mismatch
vectors.reason: Each operation receipt inputHash is recomputed from the exact signed operation payload.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-synthetic-output-hash-mismatch
vectors.reason: The candidate test proof profile recomputes outputHash; its fixture formula is not a claim about production Demos bytes.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-synthetic-effects-root-mismatch
vectors.reason: The candidate test proof profile recomputes effectsRoot over its disclosed pre/post fixture state.

vectors.name: aw-operation-root-empty-primitive
vectors.reason: The empty RFC 6962-style primitive has its exact defined boundary root; Work intents themselves remain non-empty.

vectors.name: aw-operation-root-odd-primitive
vectors.reason: An odd three-leaf tree uses the largest-power-of-two split without duplicating its last leaf.

vectors.name: aw-committed-partial-status
vectors.reason: A committed Work cannot report one rolled-back critical operation.

vectors.name: aw-rollback-proves-unchanged
vectors.reason: The included rollback establishes this Work's failure and unchanged business state without claiming global attempt absence.

vectors.name: aw-committed-receipt-fee-rule-mismatch
vectors.reason: Committed receipt envelope effects must satisfy the authenticated fee rule.

vectors.name: aw-rollback-receipt-fee-rule-mismatch
vectors.reason: Rollback preserves business state but still reports the authenticated native fee and nonce effects.

vectors.name: aw-rollback-state-leak
vectors.reason: A rollback witness exposing a payment-slot effect is rejected.

vectors.name: aw-nonce-does-not-authorize-payment
vectors.reason: Persistent envelope effects do not authorize a second payment.

vectors.name: aw-rollback-not-global-absence
vectors.reason: Claiming global absence crosses the semantic boundary of what an included rollback proves.

vectors.name: aw-lifecycle-noninclusion-proof
vectors.reason: Authenticated lifecycle evidence, not a client observation, establishes non-inclusion.

vectors.name: aw-lifecycle-native-ref-mismatch
vectors.reason: Lifecycle evidence must bind the exact native transaction reference being queried.

vectors.name: aw-lifecycle-missing-proof
vectors.reason: Missing non-inclusion evidence occupies the indeterminate proof-availability boundary.

vectors.name: aw-finality-proof-contradicted
vectors.reason: Contradictory proof material crosses the proof-status boundary into rejection.

vectors.name: aw-finality-proof-missing
vectors.reason: A receipt missing schema-required finality evidence is rejected before semantic verification.

vectors.name: aw-crash-before-admission
vectors.reason: At the pre-admission crash boundary, reconciliation does not infer absence.

vectors.name: aw-crash-before-admission-infers-absence
vectors.reason: A crash before durable admission cannot cross the evidence boundary into inferred absence.

vectors.name: aw-crash-overlay-rollback
vectors.reason: At the overlay crash boundary, recovery preserves the exact pre-state.

vectors.name: aw-crash-overlay-state-leak
vectors.reason: A business-state change across the overlay crash boundary is rejected.

vectors.name: aw-crash-after-commit-recovery
vectors.reason: At the post-commit crash boundary, recovery reproduces the same receipt and winner.

vectors.name: aw-crash-after-commit-divergence
vectors.reason: A changed receipt or winner after the consensus-commit boundary is rejected.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-service-unavailable
vectors.reason: Receipt-service unavailability remains on the indeterminate side of the reconstruction boundary.

vectors.name: aw-anchor-projection
vectors.reason: Storage result projects from independently verifiable receipt and inclusion path.

vectors.name: aw-anchor-no-txhash-reinterpretation
vectors.reason: The operation reference is versioned and not demos:{txHash}.

vectors.name: aw-anchor-finality-field-missing
vectors.reason: The projection must emit the complete finalized CORE AnchorReceipt shape.

vectors.name: aw-anchor-nonce-mutated
vectors.reason: The projected AnchorReceipt nonce must copy the verified storage output exactly.

vectors.name: aw-anchor-networkid-shortcut-rejected
vectors.reason: A non-normative networkId member cannot substitute for CORE AnchorReceipt substrate.

vectors.name: aw-anchor-inclusion-proof-invalid
vectors.reason: A detached leaf is not evidence without a valid inclusion path.

vectors.name: aw-node-limits-and-state-preservation
vectors.reason: Node-enforced authenticated limits and consensus state survive a later indeterminate observation.

vectors.name: aw-canonical-byte-limit-equality
vectors.reason: A Work whose JCS encoding equals maxCanonicalBytes is at the inclusive admission boundary.

vectors.name: aw-operation-count-limit-equality
vectors.reason: A Work with exactly maxOperations operations is at the inclusive admission boundary.

vectors.name: aw-execution-time-limit-equality
vectors.reason: An execution at exactly maxExecutionTimeMs is at the inclusive node limit.

vectors.name: aw-proof-byte-limit-equality
vectors.reason: The canonical proof measurement preimage exactly equal to maxProofBytes is admitted.

vectors.name: aw-proof-byte-limit-one-over
vectors.reason: A proof-profile reservation one byte over maxProofBytes is rejected before execution.

vectors.name: aw-client-only-limit-check
vectors.reason: Client status and limit checks cannot replace node enforcement.

vectors.name: aw-structured-proof-identity
vectors.reason: Structured typed components remain distinct at the display-collision boundary.

vectors.name: aw-indeterminate-overwrites-auth-state
vectors.reason: Crossing from authenticated in-flight state to an indeterminate observation cannot erase the established state.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-of-another-work
vectors.reason: A complete, finalized receipt for a Work differing only in expiresAt does not bind this Work.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-execution-profile-differs
vectors.reason: A re-finalized receipt naming another executionProfile does not bind the signed Work.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-results-count-short
vectors.reason: A receipt with one operation result fewer than the Work, under a recomputed root and checkpoint, is rejected.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-operation-identity-swapped
vectors.reason: Each operation result names its Work operation's id, index and kind, under a recomputed root.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-input-hash-consistent-mismatch
vectors.reason: A verifier recomputes every inputHash; a re-rooted, re-finalized receipt with a wrong one is rejected.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-output-hash-consistent-mismatch
vectors.reason: A re-rooted, re-finalized receipt whose transfer outputHash contradicts the signed payload is rejected.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-root-claim-consistent-mismatch
vectors.reason: A finalized checkpoint over a wrong operationReceiptRoot does not make that root the RFC 6962 root of the results.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-pre-root-consistent-mismatch
vectors.reason: The business pre-state root is recomputed from the authenticated witness, not taken from the finalized receipt.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-effects-root-consistent-mismatch
vectors.reason: The effects root is recomputed from the authenticated witness, not taken from the finalized receipt.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-slot-key-other-phase
vectors.reason: A re-finalized receipt whose slot key names another phase does not bind the signed slot.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-field-changed-after-commitment
vectors.reason: A receipt member edited after its receiptCommitment was computed no longer matches the canonical receipt core.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-storage-output-address-differs
vectors.reason: A storageOutput naming another address, with a consistent outputHash and root, contradicts the signed storage payload.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-checkpoint-signed-by-buyer
vectors.reason: A finality checkpoint is authenticated only by the pinned network authority; a party-signed checkpoint is not finality.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-capability-other-network
vectors.reason: A receipt is verified only under a capability for its own networkId.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-slot-job-id-first-character-8
vectors.reason: A re-finalized receipt whose slot key jobId starts with 8 does not carry a canonical JID-1 jobId.

vectors.name: aw-rolled-back-receipt-changes-business-state
vectors.reason: A rolled-back receipt with a re-signed witness and consistent roots still cannot change business state.

vectors.name: aw-rolled-back-later-operation-marked-rolled-back
vectors.reason: Operations after the failed one are not-executed, not rolled-back, under a recomputed root.

vectors.name: aw-rolled-back-slot-generation-advanced
vectors.reason: A rolled-back Purchase slot terminal state follows the signed CAS; an advanced generation contradicts it.

vectors.name: aw-completion-receipt-control
vectors.reason: A Completion receipt copies the verified Purchase receipt's settled slot state unchanged.

vectors.name: aw-completion-receipt-slot-after-changed
vectors.reason: A Completion cannot change the payment slot it inherits from the Purchase.

vectors.name: aw-completion-slot-not-copied-from-purchase
vectors.reason: A Completion slot state that is unchanged (before == after) but is not the verified Purchase terminal state is rejected.

vectors.name: aw-completion-embeds-other-purchase-receipt
vectors.reason: The Completion's embedded Purchase receipt must be the independently verified Purchase receipt.

vectors.name: aw-completion-receipt-for-other-job
vectors.reason: A Completion for another jobId cannot reuse this Purchase receipt.

vectors.name: aw-completion-after-rolled-back-purchase
vectors.reason: A Completion after a rolled-back Purchase has no committed payment to complete.

vectors.name: aw-completion-rolled-back-control
vectors.reason: A rolled-back Completion leaves business state and the Purchase slot unchanged.

vectors.name: aw-completion-rolled-back-slot-changed
vectors.reason: A rolled-back Completion cannot change the Purchase slot metadata.

vectors.name: aw-attempt-changed-bytes-inventory-consistent
vectors.reason: An attempt whose canonicalWorkBytes differ is rejected even under a ledger inventory that names it.

vectors.name: aw-two-included-attempts-inventory-names-one
vectors.reason: Two included attempts are two winners even when the inventory names only one.

vectors.name: aw-replacement-for-included-attempt
vectors.reason: An attempt with authenticated inclusion cannot be replaced.

vectors.name: aw-lifecycle-evidence-names-other-attempt
vectors.reason: Network-signed lifecycle evidence for another attemptId does not establish this attempt's inclusion.

vectors.name: aw-replay-returns-other-winner
vectors.reason: An exact replay returns the ledger-selected winner and no other attempt.

vectors.name: aw-attempts-duplicate-attempt-id
vectors.reason: Two attempts cannot share one attemptId.

vectors.name: aw-attempt-version-unsupported
vectors.reason: An attempt with attemptVersion 2 is not AtomicWorkAttemptV1.

vectors.name: aw-canonical-byte-limit-one-over
vectors.reason: A Work one canonical byte over the authenticated limit is rejected.

vectors.name: aw-operation-count-limit-one-over
vectors.reason: A Work one operation over the authenticated limit is rejected.

vectors.name: aw-execution-time-limit-one-over
vectors.reason: A Work one millisecond over the authenticated execution-time limit is rejected.

vectors.name: aw-anchor-inclusion-path-consistent-invalid
vectors.reason: A projection whose copied and resolved inclusion paths agree but prove another leaf is rejected.

vectors.name: aw-anchor-resolved-receipt-hash-differs
vectors.reason: Resolved projection evidence for another receipt does not resolve the verified Work receipt.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-version-unsupported
vectors.reason: A re-finalized receipt with receiptVersion 2 is not AtomicWorkReceiptV1.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-signed-slot-tuple-differs
vectors.reason: A finalized receipt for a Purchase whose signed slot key names another phase than its intent tuple does not bind the payment slot.

vectors.name: aw-anchor-projection-receipt-version-unsupported
vectors.reason: A projected AnchorReceipt with receiptVersion 2 is not the CORE §5.1 AnchorReceipt the verified Work receipt projects.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-multiple-signed-slot-operations
vectors.reason: A consistently finalized Purchase receipt with two signed slot operations is rejected.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-no-signed-slot-operation
vectors.reason: A consistently finalized Purchase receipt with no signed slot operation is rejected.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-retry-prior-failure-commitment-differs
vectors.reason: The finalized receipt's complete rolled-back prior state must bind the retry intent's failure commitment and conflict digest.

vectors.name: aw-receipt-retry-prior-digest-differs
vectors.reason: The finalized receipt's complete rolled-back prior state must bind the retry intent's failure commitment and conflict digest.
